# Table of Contents

> Summarize your post with a list of headings. Add HTML anchors to Heading blocks to link them here.

<!-- START TOKEN(Autogenerated block API docs) -->
**Name:** `core/table-of-contents`
**Category:** design
**API Version:** 3
**Block Type:** Hybrid (static save + server enhancements)

> Summarize your post with a list of headings. Add HTML anchors to Heading blocks to link them here.

**Keywords:** `document outline`, `summary`

| `ordered` | `boolean` | `true` | — |

## Block Markup

This is a **hybrid block**. It saves static markup that the server may enhance during rendering.

```html
<!-- wp:table-of-contents {"headings":[],"onlyIncludeCurrentPage":false,"ordered":true} -->
<!-- Content... -->
<!-- /wp:table-of-contents -->
```
